cases.setup: Both are in one place. the second starts one tick after the first. world dial: a later stop overrides an earlier one in scope.
resolution: A acts while B is held at rate 0, so B cannot start its stop on the later tick. A perceives and acts; B does not perceive while held. The later-stop override does not apply because B's stop never lands.

A keeps acting while every other holder in scope, including B, sits at effective rate 0: B is held, does not act, does not age, and perceives nothing. B's sure-hit domain passes nothing and states no clock effect, so it cannot override A's stop, and the later-stop-overrides dial never triggers because B cannot cast a stop while held. A perceives the world; B perceives nothing until A's stop ends.
